entries.title: Leviticus 18:1
segments: ¶Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Leviticus 18:2
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: 'I am the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:3
segments: 'According to the doings of the land of Egypt, where you dwelt, you shall not do; and according to the doings of the land of Canaan, where I am bringing you, you shall not do; nor shall you walk in their ordinances.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:4
segments: 'You shall observe My judgments and keep My ordinances, to walk in them: I [am] the LORD your God.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:5
segments: 'You shall therefore keep My statutes and My judgments, which if a man does, he shall live by them: I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:6
segments: ¶'None of you shall approach anyone who is near of kin to him, to uncover his nakedness: I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:7
segments: 'The nakedness of your father or the nakedness of your mother you shall not uncover. She [is] your mother; you shall not uncover her nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:8
segments: 'The nakedness of your father's wife you shall not uncover; it [is] your father's nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:9
segments: 'The nakedness of your sister, the daughter of your father, or the daughter of your mother, [whether] born at home or elsewhere, their nakedness you shall not uncover.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:10
segments: 'The nakedness of your son's daughter or your daughter's daughter, their nakedness you shall not uncover; for theirs [is] your own nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:11
segments: 'The nakedness of your father's wife's daughter, begotten by your father-she [is] your sister-you shall not uncover her nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:12
segments: 'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's sister; she [is] near of kin to your father.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:13
segments: 'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your mother's sister, for she [is] near of kin to your mother.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:14
segments: 'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your father's brother. You shall not approach his wife; she [is] your aunt.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:15
segments: 'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your daughter-in-law-she [is] your son's wife-you shall not uncover her nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:16
segments: 'You shall not uncover the nakedness of your brother's wife; it [is] your brother's nakedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:17
segments: 'You shall not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, nor shall you take her son's daughter or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness. They [are] near of kin to her. It [is] wickedness.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:18
segments: 'Nor shall you take a woman as a rival to her sister, to uncover her nakedness while the other is alive.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:19
segments: ¶'Also you shall not approach a woman to uncover her nakedness as long as she is in her [customary] impurity.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:20
segments: 'Moreover you shall not lie carnally with your neighbor's wife, to defile yourself with her.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:21
segments: 'And you shall not let any of your descendants pass through [the fire] to Molech, nor shall you profane the name of your God: I [am] the LORD.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:22
segments: 'You shall not lie with a male as with a woman. It [is] an abomination.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:23
segments: 'Nor shall you mate with any animal, to defile yourself with it. Nor shall any woman stand before an animal to mate with it. It [is] perversion.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:24
segments: 'Do not defile yourselves with any of these things; for by all these the nations are defiled, which I am casting out before you.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:25
segments: 'For the land is defiled; therefore I visit the punishment of its iniquity upon it, and the land vomits out its inhabitants.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:26
segments: 'You shall therefore keep My statutes and My judgments, and shall not commit [any] of these abominations, [either] any of your own nation or any stranger who dwells among you

entries.title: Leviticus 18:27
segments: '(for all these abominations the men of the land have done, who [were] before you, and thus the land is defiled),

entries.title: Leviticus 18:28
segments: 'lest the land vomit you out also when you defile it, as it vomited out the nations that [were] before you.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:29
segments: 'For whoever commits any of these abominations, the persons who commit [them] shall be cut off from among their people.

entries.title: Leviticus 18:30
segments: 'Therefore you shall keep My ordinance, so that [you] do not commit [any] of these abominable customs which were committed before you, and that you do not defile yourselves by them: I [am] the LORD your God.'"
